data.title: One year after Putin-Trump summit, 'spirit of Anchorage' dissipated
data.description: MOSCOW — In the year since United States President Donald Trump hosted Russian President Vladimir Putin on US soil for a summit designed to broker an end to Russia's offensive on Ukraine, the diplomatic initiative has fizzled out and the conflict has escalated.

data.title: Ceuta leader wants migrant detention centre after influx
data.description: MADRID - The leader of Ceuta demanded on Monday the detention and expulsion of the thousands of migrants wandering the Spanish north African territory's streets after last month's mass influx from Morocco.

data.title: Torment of Afghan fathers as daughters deprived of education
data.description: KABUL - Father after father Agence France-Presse ( AFP ) spoke to in Afghanistan about the education ban that stops their daughters going beyond primary school choked up in despair.

data.title: Return of displaced Syrian Kurds to hometown suspended after violence
data.description: HASAKEH (SYRIA) - The return of displaced Syrian Kurds to their northeastern hometown of Ras al-Ain was suspended on Monday after a first group of returnees was attacked, prompting protests in other Kurdish-majority parts of Syria.

data.title: Farage vs Count Binface: What to know about UK snap poll
data.description: LONDON - Hard-right UK politician Nigel Farage will be fighting for his parliamentary seat Thursday, going head-to-head with parody candidate Count Binface in snap polls.

data.title: Trump order pushes for overhaul of childhood vaccine schedule
data.description: WASHINGTON - US President Donald Trump signed an executive order on Monday pushing for a rethink of school vaccine mandates and repeating calls for the measles, mumps, and rubella (MMR) vaccine to be separated into three individual shots.

data.title: Colombia declares state of emergency after quake kills 111
data.description: PEREIRA (COLOMBIA) - Colombia on Monday declared a state of emergency following a powerful earthquake that caused at least 111 deaths and flattened dozens of buildings, trapping more victims underneath.

data.title: Trump insists Netanyahu relationship 'very good' despite Gaza rift
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - President Donald Trump insisted on Monday that his relationship with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is "very good" despite the Israeli leader's rejection of a US-led Gaza plan.

data.title: Russia bars only anti-war party from elections
data.description: MOSCOW - Russia's Supreme Court on Monday barred the country's only anti-war party, Yabloko, from contesting September's parliamentary elections.

data.title: 'Dreams disappear' as Gaza students await evacuation to Italy
data.description: ROME - Dozens of Gaza students who won scholarships to universities in Italy are still waiting to be evacuated due to bureaucratic red tape, leaving qualified students in a deadly conflict zone, AFP has found.

data.title: Turkey MPs back historic law on reintegrating Kurdish militants
data.description: ISTANBUL - Turkish lawmakers on Monday voted through a bill offering limited amnesty for Kurdish PKK militants, a key step in the peace process that seeks to end decades of deadly violence.

data.title: Drought forces water restrictions across nearly 70% of France
data.description: PARIS — Nearly 70% of France is subject to water-use restrictions as drought conditions worsen amid successive heatwaves, the government said Monday.

data.title: UK radio broke rules in announcing king's death: watchdog
data.description: LONDON - A community radio station breached the rules after accidentally announcing the death of King Charles III in a May broadcast, a UK watchdog said on Monday.

data.title: Europe braces for another summer heatwave
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Much of Europe is bracing for yet another heatwave following periods of scorching temperatures that have driven rivers to record lows, ignited historic forest fires and contributed to thousands of deaths.

data.title: Days of heavy rain leave at least 13 dead in Philippines
data.description: MANILA - Floods, landslides and accidents driven by a nine-day downpour equivalent to more than a month's worth of rain in some areas have killed at least 13 people in the northern Philippines, rescuers said Monday.

data.title: Ex-Thai MP shoots dead local official over money row
data.description: BANGKOK - A former Thai MP on Monday shot dead a local government official in broad daylight over a financial dispute before being arrested and confessing to journalists at the police station.

data.title: Record July heat in regions home to 900 million people
data.description: PARIS — Regions home to around 900 million people experienced their hottest July on record in 2026, including in the Sahel, Central America, France and Spain, according to Agence France-Presse ( AFP ) analysis of Copernicus data.

data.title: US, South Korea to drill for new threats from North
data.description: SEOUL — South Korean and US forces will hold major joint drills next week simulating combat against North Korean troops battle-hardened by deployment in the Russia-Ukraine war, an exercise spokesman said Monday.

data.title: One woman confirmed dead in western Canada wildfire
data.description: MONTREAL (CANADA) - An 80-year-old woman died while fleeing her home to escape a massive wildfire in Canada's British Columbia province, the Royal Canadian Mounted Police (RCMP) said late Sunday.

data.title: Typhoon Dolphin weakens but disrupts travel in east China
data.description: BEIJING - Typhoon Dolphin brought heavy rain to eastern China on Monday, causing hundreds of flight cancellations even as the storm weakened and some cities resumed public transport.

data.title: Self-taught Turkish 'linguist' keeps dead language alive
data.description: CAVUSTEPE, VAN PROVINCE, Turkey - Mehmet Kusman did not spend very long at school, but he traced the ancient inscriptions chiselled into the black basalt rock and read: "Before me there was nothing. But by the power of the god Haldi I founded this city."

data.title: Air India captain's initial drug screening prompts further testing after sudden altitude loss
data.description: NEW DELHI - ⁠The ⁠captain of an Air ​India flight from Phuket to New Delhi that encountered a sudden ​loss of altitude last week returned ‌an initial screening result for psychoactive substances, prompting further laboratory testing, India's Civil Aviation Ministry said on Sunday.

data.title: Western Europe experienced hottest June-July on record: EU monitor
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Western Europe experienced its hottest June-July on record as climate change fuels an historic summer of heat, drought and wildfires across the region, the EU's global warming monitor said Monday.

data.title: Syria says reached deal with Moscow on fate of Russian bases
data.description: DAMASCUS - Syria said on Sunday that it reached a deal with Russia on the fate of its two bases in the country, which Moscow once used to provide military support to ousted leader Bashar al-Assad during the Syrian civil war.

data.title: Kurdish PKK criticises Turkey bill on fate of its fighters
data.description: ISTANBUL - Outlawed Kurdish group the PKK on Sunday criticised a proposed Turkish law setting out the fate of its fighters after disarmament, a day before parliament prepares to consider it.

data.title: Bodies hanging from bridge revive violence in once-calm town in Mexico
data.description: POZOS DE GAMBOA (MEXICO) - Horrific drug violence plagued the Mexican state of Zacatecas for years, until relative calm set in. Then one morning in July this small town woke up to find five bodies dangling from a bridge -- a grim calling card that showed the bloodshed never really left.

data.title: Five dead in new Russia, Ukraine strikes
data.description: KYIV (UKRAINE) - Russian strikes killed two people and wounded dozens across Ukraine overnight Saturday and Sunday, while a Ukrainian drone attack killed three people in Russia's Belgorod region.
